name: Friends of Parks and Nature Grants

funder.name: South Australia Department for Environment and Water

summary: Annual grants of up to AUD 15,000 for volunteer Friends of Parks and Nature groups doing conservation work in South Australian parks and reserves, including minor equipment, over up to 18 months.

eligibility.rule: Registered Friends of Parks and Nature member group, endorsed by a Regional Parks and Wildlife Manager
Incorporated, or sponsored by an incorporated organisation
No outstanding grant acquittals, unless a variation was approved
Project is backed by an approved plan or the relevant Regional Parks & Wildlife Manager

eligibility.quote: Applicant groups must be a current financial member registered with Friends of Parks and Nature Inc. and have received endorsement from a Regional Parks and Wildlife Manager
Grant funding supports projects that span up to 18 months in duration.
Applicant groups must be incorporated or sponsored by an incorporated organisation, such as a local government authority, Local Action Planning Group, or Friends of Parks and Nature (FOPN) Inc.
Applicant groups must not have any outstanding grant acquittals unless prior approval has been obtained via a grant variation request.

Projects must be supported by an approved plan, e.g. park management plan, regional landscape plan, biodiversity plan, fire management plan, species recovery plan and/or supported by the relevant Regional Parks & Wildlife Manager.

co_finance_required.quote: groups must demonstrate an in-kind or co-contribution to their project of at least 50% of the funding amount being sought. This contribution can be via volunteer hours, other funds or other in-kind contributions

documents.quote: Where a sponsor is required, the sponsorship arrangement must be confirmed in writing and attached to the application.
Please note that the relevant landholder’s current permission is required as part of the application.
If legislative approvals or permits are required to carry out the proposed works these must also be attached to the application (e.g. CASA license for drone use).

after_award.quote: A final grant acquittal and project report will be required from an authorised group representative upon completion of the project.
